oracle.name: Power Pages portal over Dataverse (Liquid fetchxml and portal Web API)
oracle.scope: Two signed-in runs of a hosted Power Pages site (classic authorization) over a synthetic item, child and hierarchy fixture: FetchXML as Liquid {% fetchxml %} and as the Web API fetchXml parameter, covering hierarchy, identity, union-hint and link-type operators, filter links, paging beyond the end and an authored top. Only cases equal in both runs whose rows stay inside the item fixture are recorded. Names and ids are invented; the exact hosted build is unrecorded.
